+    v = (uv[1] + .5) * 1024 / SIZE - .5

+def follow_polygon(s, points, z, speed):
+    # Targets follow the planned path independently of measured tracking lag.
+    prev = points[0]
+    for nxt in points[1:] + points[:1]:
+        d = np.linalg.norm(nxt - prev)
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(d / (speed / 20))))
+        for j in range(1, n + 1):
+            xy = prev + (nxt - prev) * j / n
+            q, ok, err = s.ik((xy[0], xy[1], z))

+
+
+def order_paths(paths, xy):

+    while remain:

+        path = remain.pop(i)
+        yield path
+        xy = path[0][0]
+
+
+def main():

+    ap.add_argument('--limit', type=int, default=10000)
